This Voyager 52-inch smart ceiling fan offers a handy remote, a specialized Carro Home APP, and voice control that works with Alexa, Google Assistant, and Siri Shortcuts to adjust the fan speeds, dim the LED light, reverse fan direction, set timers and schedules. Set the yellow light to 20% and daylight to 100% during work time.

This 5-blades ceiling fan offers up to 10 levels of wind speed, delivers ultra-powerful airflow with a maximum of 4500 CFM, and only produces 58Db noise. This indoor ceiling fan supports a timer setting that shut the fan off after 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8 hours automatically.
Schedule Function: 
Using the modern schedule function, you can program this modern ceiling fan with dimmable LED light to meet your exact routine needs. Create a cool environment in advance or set your fan to turn off for bedtime by setting multiple schedules all from one convenient smart app.
Indoor & Outdoor Ceiling fan 
This ceiling fan is perfect for indoor or covered outdoor spaces. The fan has moisture resistance that allows the fan install outdoor like on patios, porches, and garages. Stylish design make the reversible ceiling fan suitable for living room, bedroom, kitchen, baby room, and study room.
